dynamicportals.command.bread.help:
§6[DynamicPortals]§r
The dynamic portals command is similar to the execute command, having multiple different arguments which can be filled in in any order.

§3For help, run /dynamic_portals network or /dynamic_portals portal
dynamicportals.command.bread.help.networ:
§3[Network]
§a/dynamic_portals network create [network_name]§r
This creates a portal network with the given name.
Portal networks can contain one, two, or more portals.
If there are more than two portals, a subspace will be created so that the player can navigate between the portals.
Portals get linked automatically if there are two portals on one network.
You can delete the network using §a/dynamic_portals network delete [network_name]§r
dynamicportals.command.bread.help.portal:
§3[Portal]
§a/dynamic_portals portal create [network_name] [portal_type] [arguments+]§r

These arguments depend on the type of portal you want to make.
For the basic portal type, the args are as follows:
§aFormat: §e[Required/Optional, Type, Name]§r
  §6[Req, Vec2, size]§r Size: two decimal numbers representing how large the portal should be.
  §6[Opt, Vec3, position]§r Position: the position of the portal.
  §6[Opt, Vec3, rotation]§r Rotation: which direction the portal should be facing. This can be written as a combination of pitch and yaw, a euler angle, or a quaternion.
  §6[Opt, Bool, frontonly]§r Front Only: whether or not the back side should be able to render/

§6[Examples]
§a/dynamic_portals portal create test dynamicportals:basic size 5 5§r
creates a portal with a width and height of 5, at the player's (or executor's) feet, and rotated the way the player is facing, in the network named "test".
